feeds.title: The Animal Rescue Site News
feeds.description: The Animal Rescue Site provides food and vital care for some of the eight million unwanted animals given to shelters every year in the U.S., as well as animals in desperate need around the world.

feeds.title: Pibbles & More Animal Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Pibbles n More Animal Rescue Inc. was created for the purpose of rescuing homeless and abandoned companion animals. All of our pets are placed in foster homes until they are adopted by an approved home. Pibbles n More Animal Rescue Inc. is staffed solely by volunteers who love and want to help homeless animals.

feeds.title: Dogs Blog
feeds.description: DogsBlog.com is a dedicated platform launched in 2007, focusing on finding new homes for shelter dogs across the UK. It works in partnership with over 500 shelters and has successfully rehomed over 70,000 dogs, offering a win-win solution by saving millions in welfare costs. The blog seeks to accelerate the adoption process by spotlighting rescue dogs available for immediate adoption, thereby reducing the duration dogs spend in shelters.

feeds.title: North Shore Animal League America Blog
feeds.description: North Shore Animal League America is the world's largest no-kill rescue and adoption organization. With your help, we can save defenseless animals each day. Here you will find adoption tips, training, medical and legal advice, celebrity news and so much more!

feeds.title: Rescue Reporter News
feeds.description: Rescue Reporter-News is passionate about bringing attention to animal causes and sharing educational content to raise awareness about animal welfare.

feeds.title: Animal Rescue League of Boston
feeds.description: The Animal Rescue League of Boston is an unwavering champion for animals in need, committed to keeping them safe and healthy in habitats and homes.

feeds.title: Alberta Animal Rescue Crew Society Blog
feeds.description: The Alberta Animal Rescue Crew Society (AARCS) is a grassroots animal welfare organization with a foundation of compassion and kindness, embodied by its hard-working staff, volunteers, foster homes, and supporters. Our goal is to help homeless animals in communities across Alberta.

feeds.title: Doobert Blog
feeds.description: Doobert is about bringing together Animal rescue volunteers and Rescue and shelter organizations to save animals. Our technology powers your passion for animals and allows you to choose how to get involved. Our mission is to support animal rescue organizations and their volunteers by improving the coordination and communications required during animal rescue.

feeds.title: TEARS Animal Rescue
feeds.description: TEARS Animal Rescue (The Emma Animal Rescue Society) is one of the country's leading organisations; its mission is to rescue, rehabilitate and re-home domestic animals, as well as provide veterinary services to local communities. Our vision is one of continuous improvement and expansion in order to rescue, rehabilitate, re-home, or re-unite every domestic animal that has nowhere else to turn.

feeds.title: Pawlytics
feeds.description: Read the latest animal rescue research, findings, and learn how to use your animal shelter statistics to your organization's advantage. Pawlytics is a cloud-based software for animal shelters and rescues who want to save more animals and love their database while doing it.

feeds.title: Second Chance Animal Rescue Society
feeds.description: Second Chance Animal Rescue Society (SCARS) is a non-profit Edmonton and Athabasca based registered charity that is almost entirely volunteer operated.

feeds.title: Lola The Rescued Cat
feeds.description: A humorous blog written from a cat's perspective on life, supporting rescue and responsible pet parenting.

feeds.title: Regina Cat Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Regina Cat Rescue (RCR) is a non-profit, volunteer-run organization and registered charity that helps abandoned cats and kittens and educates people about the humane treatment of pets.

feeds.title: Home for Good Dog Rescue
feeds.description: Home for Good Dog Rescue is a foster and volunteer based, 501(c)(3) non-profit dog rescue organization. Our mission is to rescue, nurture and adopt dogs into loving homes for good. We strive to give the dogs another chance at life. Home for Good is run by dedicated professionals who volunteer their time and resources to help homeless animals.

feeds.title: Hanaeleh Horse Rescue and Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: Hanaeleh is a non-profit horse rescue in Orange County, CA. Hanaeleh is dedicated to rescuing abused and abandoned horses. We rescue all breeds and ages of horses, and after we rehabilitate them, we work to find them new loving homes. When horses are not adoptable due to severe neglect or abuse, we provide sanctuary for them to live out their days knowing they'll always be loved and cared for.

feeds.title: Freshfields Animal Rescue Blog
feeds.description: We rescue, rehabilitate and rehome over 2000 animals and birds every year. Ours is a genuine non destruction policy and any animal we cannot rehome or place in foster has a home at the rescue for life.

feeds.title: 2 Traveling Dogs
feeds.description: Join on the Adventure Of A Lifetime across the USA as we visit 48 states and 48 animal rescues with our 2 Traveling Dogs, Peanut Butter Brickle and Digby Pancake! We wanted to give back and highlight the people behind animal rescue who are making a difference.

feeds.title: Buddha Dog Rescue & Recovery
feeds.description: Buddha Dog Rescue & Recovery (BDRR) successfully reunites families with their lost pets. When a pet goes missing it is a frightening, stressful situation, taking the proper steps immediately and implementing a plan is essential.

feeds.title: CK Animal Rescue
feeds.description: CK Animal Rescue offers shelter and support to all dogs & cats no matter how desperate their prospects may seem. This undertaking enevitabely requires continious funding for medications & care. Our mission is to rescue dogs from high kill shelters who have no time left, through no fault of their own as well as local dogs & other animals being surrendered place them in foster homes until adopted.

feeds.title: Secret World Wildlife Rescue
feeds.description: Secret World Wildlife Rescue specialises in the rescue, rehabilitation & eventual release of orphaned & injured wild creatures. It is run entirely on donations & runs a wildlife rescue service in the South West of England. Our mission is to undertake the care & rehabilitation of orphaned, injured & otherwise distressed wildlife and to return all creatures, to the wild or find them suitable homes.

feeds.title: RVR Horse Rescue
feeds.description: RVR Horse Rescue, Inc is a horse rescue facility located in Riverview, Florida dedicated to saving and rehabilitating horses. Our goal is to rescue the ones we can, and although we realize we can't save them all, we believe each horse we can save is worth fighting for. We provide each horse with the care, training, and space they need to recover.

feeds.title: PAART - Pittsburgh Aviation Animal Rescue Team Blog
feeds.description: Pittsburgh Aviation Animal Rescue Team coordinates and transports thousands of animals to their new homes free of charge. Follow along with the Pittsburgh Aviation Animal Rescue Team as we fly and drive thousands of at risk animals from danger to safety.

feeds.title: The Feral Life Compassion Cats
feeds.description: The Feral Cat Rescue Project photoblog is an attempt to document the lives of feral cats and their plight. I do my best to feed and care for them, and to protect them from danger.

feeds.title: The Cat's Meow Rescue - Blog: Feline Friends
feeds.description: The Cat's Meow Rescue (TCMR) is a group of cat advocates that have come together to help the cats of the Northeast Texas shelters.The goal of The Cat's Meow Rescue is to save the lives of cats, and often litters of kittens, that have been abandoned at kill shelters.

feeds.title: HOPE Dog Rescue
feeds.description: Hopedogrescue; a collective of people from all walks of life gathered together and dedicated to a singular purpose of delivering hope and love to the ones that need it most - our street dogs. We help animals who are abused, neglected and abandoned.

feeds.title: Southport-Oak Island Animal Rescue - SOAR Blog
feeds.description: SOAR is a non-profit, no-kill animal rescue that provides shelter, medical treatment, healthy food, daily care & lots of love to lost/abandoned dogs & cats.

feeds.title: Dog Gone Seattle
feeds.description: Dog Gone Seattle is a 501c3 Dog Rescue dedicated to saving dogs at risk for euthanasia. Our mission is to rescue and rehabilitation of homeless dogs from high-kill shelters in Washington and beyond through fostering and adoption in greater Seattle area.

feeds.title: DogTipper
feeds.description: DogTipper is a positive place celebrating dog rescue! They help you celebrate life with your dog by including them in your daily life. The founders Paris Permenter, and John Bigley have written 35 travel and pet books. They help you with tips, homemade dog treat recipes, and year-round pet holidays. They also suggest amazing dog names and activities to do with your dog.

feeds.title: Pet Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Pet Rescue Blog is a pet and dog blog with amazing pet tips and tricks for your cute animal as well as sales to buy the best stuff for your friend.

feeds.title: Zoe's Animal Rescue
feeds.description: We are a rescue who specializes in finding forever homes for animals in need while ensuring the best fit for each one. Our mission at Zoe's Animal Rescue is to make positive changes in the lives of cats and dogs in need. We strive to save one animal at a time, acknowledging that 'saving one animal will not change the world, but for that animal, the world will change forever.

feeds.title: National Mill Dog Rescue Blog
feeds.description: National Mill Dog Rescue rescues, rehabilitates and re-homes retired commercial breeding dogs from puppy mills, giving these dogs a new beginning and a final chance to find happiness and comfort in a loving home.

feeds.title: North Meck Animal Rescue
feeds.description: Non profit, no kill animal rescue in Charlotte NC helping to end pet abandonment, abuse and neglect. Our mission is to help end pet overpopulation, abandonment and neglect. We provide care and find homes for dogs of any breed, age or medical need.

feeds.title: Second Chance Animal Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Second Chance Animal Rescue is a registered charity that operates with the help of foster carers & volunteer to rescue & rehome dogs and cats that need a second chance. Second Chance Animal Rescue is a Pro-Life organisation in Melbourne Victoria. Our aim is to connect the dots, do what needs to be done for these guys so eventually they will end up at their perfect forever home and never look back.

feeds.title: Animal Rescue New Orleans
feeds.description: Animal Rescue New Orleans (ARNO) is an organization created and dedicated to the rescue and aid of abandoned and homeless animals in the New Orleans area, including responding to the immediate needs of those in need of medical care or those too old, too young, too sick, neglected, abused and deprived of love. Our mission is to aid abandoned and homeless animals and, through education and support.

feeds.title: One Love Animal Rescue | One Love One Life at a Time
feeds.description: The mission of One Love Animal Rescue, Inc. is to help abandoned, neglected, abused and unwanted pets by partnering with shelters, rescue groups and the community to facilitate adoption of these animals into permanent and loving homes. Our goal is to save one life at a time by promoting local animal shelter adoptions and raising awareness in our community about responsible pet ownership.

feeds.title: Take Me Home Pet Rescue | Richardson, TX
feeds.description: TMHPR, located in Richardson, TX, a non-profit, foster-based rescue with the goal of finding Forever Homes for homeless pets. Our pets live in foster homes, we learn their personalities, train, and fully vet them, before finding the right Forever Family.

feeds.title: Ring Dog Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Ring Dog Rescue is a Richmond Va based non-profit rescue organization. We focus on saving, rehabilitating, and adopting out pitbull type dogs into loving homes. RDR also puts a large emphasis on education and community outreach.

feeds.title: Friends of Felines' Rescue Center
feeds.description: Friends of Felines' Rescue Center is a non-profit, cage free, no-kill feline care facility. Our goal is to adopt our kittens & cats into permanent loving indoor homes and to reduce homelessness, abuse, and euthanasia due to animal overpopulation. We operate solely on the kindness of private donations, and receive no local or federal government funding.

feeds.title: Dogwood Animal Rescue Project
feeds.description: Volunteer driven non-profit organization dedicated to rescuing dogs and cats in Northern California and finding their permanent homes.

feeds.title: Randall's Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Randall's Rescue is a New Jersey-based, no-kill, non-profit animal rescue. Our mission is to put an end to euthanasia in shelters and to have no more homeless or stray pets by adoption, TNR, spay/neuter and educating the public.

feeds.title: Nevada SPCA Animal Rescue
feeds.description: The Nevada SPCA, a nonprofit organization, operates a no-kill animal sanctuary, promotes humane education, makes referrals for lower-cost spay/neuter and vaccination services, and challenges people to be the best possible guardians for the companion animals in their care.

feeds.title: Demi's Animal Rescue
feeds.description: Demi's Animal Rescue is a no kill animal rescue that focuses on complete rehabilitation. With the goal of bringing Colorado closer to a no kill state, we focus on the mending of individual creatures, both physically and emotionally, then finding the best matches for adoption.

feeds.title: True Blue Animal Rescue | TBAR
feeds.description: True Blue Animal Rescue is a no-kill animal rescue focused on helping domestic animals in need due to abuse or neglect situations. TBAR takes in animal from personal rescues and through team efforts with law enforcement or veterinarian hospitals. TBAR strives to educate the public on proper pet care, and to advocate the prevention of pet overpopulation through spay and neuter funding options.

feeds.title: 8 Lives: Sheffield 8 Cat Rescue
feeds.description: We are a new and very small rescue, set up with the aim of helping cats in need in the Sheffield 8 post code. '8 Lives' reflects both the post code and the sad reality that cats and kittens who come to us have invariably lost at least one of their 9 lives by the time they get to us.

feeds.title: Rudozem Street Dog Rescue
feeds.description: Rudozem Street Dog Rescue (RSDR) is a non-profit foundation that rescues Street Dogs in Bulgaria and finds loving homes for them in the UK, Netherlands and Belgium.

feeds.title: Newf Friends Newfoundland Dog Rescue
feeds.description: A network of volunteers working together to help Newfoundland Dogs in need across Ontario. We are a foster home based rescue group with a strong emphasis on education. We strive to prevent surrendering of dogs by working with families to problem solve and resolve issues that they are facing that may force them to surrender their dog.

feeds.title: Casa del Toro Pit Bull Rescue - Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1997 Casa Del Toro Pit Bull Rescue is a nonprofit organization. We rescue dogs identified as pit bulls from shelters across Indiana.

feeds.title: Feline Rescue Cat Tales
feeds.description: Feline Rescue, Inc. is a Minnesota based no-kill companion cat rescue nonprofit organization. All volunteer run with no paid staff. We provide rescue and relief to the homeless and endangered cats in our community through programs that offer shelter, foster, social and medical rehabilitation, feral and stray management, spay/neuter subsidy, and community education.

feeds.title: Our Companions Animal Rescue
feeds.description: Our Companions is a Connecticut-based nonprofit organization that believes no pet should ever be homeless. Every pet is a beautiful, blessed creature who deserves life and love. Our mission is to lead a humane movement to protect and advocate for the lives of companion animals. creating a sanctuary to rescue those who would otherwise be destroyed.

feeds.title: Thrive Animal Rescue
feeds.description: Thrive Animal Rescue is an organization founded by Cece Bloum, whose mission is to place homeless dogs with their forever families. We will be removing at-risk dogs from high kill shelters and fostering them as we look for the perfect fit. Please join us in our quest to improve the world, one homeless dog at a time.

feeds.title: MK Cat Rescue
feeds.description: Passionate about giving all cats a second chance and a safe loving home. We can help if you need to re-home your own cat and assist with finding homes for strays or the trap, neuter and return of feral cats. Rescue lost, stray or abandoned cats. A blog about cats - adopt, foster, volunteer or donate.

feeds.title: Animal Antics - Fun with Rescued Animals
feeds.description: We are a small privately owned 501(c)(3) (non-profit, EIN 20-5988307) no kill animal rescue and have been rescuing animals for more than 25 years. We rescue mainly large animals, including horses, goats, llamas and even some Zebus. Our animals come through various sources: from families that can't keep their pets to organizations such as the Zoo.

feeds.title: The SARF Blog
feeds.description: The Stuffed Animal Rescue Foundation (S.A.R.F.) is an organization dedicated to the well-being of abandoned, outgrown or neglected Stuffed Animals.* We find permanent and/or foster homes for rescued Stuffed Animals (SAs), and we provide shelter, snuggles and good conversation in the interim.

feeds.title: Lighthouse Animal Rescue
feeds.description: All the latest from Mr. BudBud, the perro primero of Lighthouse Animal Rescue in Atenas Costa Rica.

feeds.title: Abandoned Animal Rescue Lost / Found Blog
feeds.description: A public service to help lost pets find their owners. This is not linked to Abandoned Animal Rescue (AAR) the shelter located in Tomball, TX.

feeds.title: CatTipper
feeds.description: A positive place to share the joy rescue cats bring pet parents. Tips, product reviews, giveaways and more.

feeds.title: Animal Rescue Konnection Blog
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on animal behavior, health & safety, rescue heroes, social justice, and training. Animal Rescue Konnection (ARK) is a rescue organization that specializes in helping dogs that are hard-to-place and mislabeled.

feeds.title: Rescue Allies
feeds.description: We take the leg work out of the day-to-day so rescues and shelters can focus on the important stuff - saving lives. We provide resources to increase adoptions, improve volunteer training, build foster teams, and much more.

feeds.title: Rocket Dog Rescue
feeds.description: Rocket Dog Rescue is a San Francisco Bay Area dog rescue organization run by a group of dedicated volunteers. Rocket Dog Rescue's ultimate goal is to create a world where all companion animals have loving and permanent homes and where no good natured dogs, no matter what their age, are killed in shelters because they are considered to be surplus or unadoptable.

feeds.title: Big Fluffy Dog Rescue
feeds.description: Big Fluffy Dog Rescue is a 501(c)(3) organization dedicated to helping giant breed mixed breed dogs in need. Our dogs come in to rescue for many different reasons. Many were abandoned at high kill shelters. Some were turned in by owners who could not properly care for them and still others are failed livestock guardian dogs. Our goal for every dog we have is the same: a safe, happy home.

feeds.title: Animal Place
feeds.description: Animal Place rescues farmed animals from slaughter, provides them with permanent sanctuary or homes, and promotes veganism. We operate a 600-acre sanctuary in Grass Valley, California and a 60-acre adoption center in Vacaville, Calif. Each year, more than 2,500 chickens, turkeys, goats, sheep and other farmed animals find new homes through our rescue and adoption program.

feeds.title: SAINTS Rescue
feeds.description: SAINTS is an end-of-life sanctuary for senior and special needs animals that have nowhere else to go. We provide a special place to be loved, cherished, and receive proper medical care for the rest of their days.

feeds.title: WIRES Australian Wildlife Rescue Organisation Blog
feeds.description: WIRES aims to actively rehabilitate and preserve Australian wildlife and inspire others to do the same. Read about WIRES native animal rescue and care stories and updates on WIRES work with wildlife.

feeds.title: Arizona Humane Society: Transforming Animal Welfare
feeds.description: Every pet deserves a good life. With a vision to end animal suffering, we rescue, heal, adopt and advocate for sick, injured and abused animals.The latest stories, adorable adoptables, amazing animal rescues, pet health and behavior tips and more from the Arizona Humane Society Blog!

feeds.title: Hope For Paws Blog
feeds.description: The latest blog posts from Hope for Paws share interesting animal rescue stories and education. Hope for Paws is a non-profit animal rescue organization. We rescue dogs, cats, and other types of animals suffering on the streets or neglected in the wild.

feeds.title: PawSafe Animal Rescue
feeds.description: PawSafe Animal Rescue appreciates all the rescues and independent rescuers out there working tirelessly to save lives. PawSafe Animal Rescue exists to provide a better life for adoptable companion animals without homes and to assist in the effort to limit the overpopulation of these animals through a low kill methodology.

feeds.title: 4Life Animal Rescue - Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to 4Life Animal Rescue! We are a 501(c)3 charitable organization, located in beautiful Orange County, California. Our mission at 4Life Animal Rescue is to provide care and resources to animals in need. We offer adoption, education, training, and rehabilitation services to ensure that unwanted and neglected animals are safe and receive the life-long care they require and deserve.

feeds.title: Pet Samaritans
feeds.description: The Pet Samaritans animal sanctuary in Derbyshire provides pet adoption services, wildlife rescue, hedgehog hospital and lifetime pet care for owners.

feeds.title: Back Roads Animal Rescue​ Blog
feeds.description: Back Roads Dog Rescue focuses on dogs but the mission of the rescue is to help any animals in need in the long term plan. Stay tuned for exciting changes and growth as we gain momentum with community support and action. We are currently seeking qualified foster homes for all of the animals we encounter.

feeds.title: Central Virginia Horse Rescue | CVHR
feeds.description: Central Virginia Horse Rescue is a 501c3 non profit that is dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of abused, neglected and slaughterbound horses.

feeds.title: Perfect Match Animal Rescue
feeds.description: Perfect Match Animal Rescue was founded by Jill Thorsen several years ago & initially functioned as a cat rescue. Mission is to reduce the number of animals surrendered to shelters by intervening with owner surrenders where possible, rescue animals from these shelters when foster homes are available to accommodate,& help fund vaccine programs & spay/neuter education in rural & impoverished areas.
